violated_contract: Every BGTaskScheduler launch handler must be registered exactly once per process and before application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:) returns. With UIScene, plugin instances are created after launch (storyboard engine) and Flutter's scene fallback can deliver didFinishLaunching to plugins a second time on a launch with options (URL, notification, quick action); a registration in a plugin init or an unguarded plugin didFinishLaunching raises NSInternalInconsistencyException at launch.
canonical_prevention: Register app-owned identifiers from AppDelegate didFinishLaunching and hand tasks to the plugin once it exists; guard any plugin-owned registration with a once-per-process check at its single call site.
